The '''Cassander system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], inside the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], that was founded by the narcissistic [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Cassander Tadrin]], circa [[122 BBY]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cassander]].
